fresh_internal_checks.check: The dimension remains at least two and the initial manifold/background hypotheses remain in force.
Modification descent supplies genuine admissible pullbacks and positive curvature currents even though the pulled-back background need not be Hermitian.
The coefficientwise restriction defining polar curvature is meaningful for those positive currents.
Blowing up the actual isolated pole gives one exceptional divisor and no other poles.
The local chart z=(s,sw) converts the isolated logarithm to a log|s|^2 term with the same coefficient and bounded remainder.
The generic Lelong number on the exceptional divisor equals that coefficient in the established normalization.
A local smooth correction with larger Hessian produces a closed positive current.
The existing local Siu/divisorial restriction fact, whose nonclosed extension proof was read, gives exactly a[E] on the exceptional divisor.
Subtracting the smooth correction changes no coefficient mass on that divisor; closedness of the original background is not used.
Wedging with the fixed smooth Hermitian eta gives a positive measure of finite strictly positive mass on the exceptional divisor.
The difference of the two polar trace measures is (a-b) times this same positive measure, proving the exact variation formula.
Each prescribed modification admits a proper closed analytic bad set in the base and is an isomorphism over its complement.
A proper analytic subset of a connected complex manifold is nowhere dense.
The compact manifold is a Baire space, so the countable union of the bad sets cannot exhaust it.
One point outside all bad sets can be chosen before the isolated-pole witness family is constructed.
The witness threshold depends only on that point and the original background, not on infinitely many extra curvature inequalities.
Each modification has exactly one point over that pole and is biholomorphic near it, so the pulled-back logarithmic estimate is unchanged.
The old trace estimate requires a smooth local background and positivity of the curvature current, not strict positivity of the background.
That estimate rules out coefficient mass at the only upstairs pole in every prescribed modification.
The original proposition already proves different ordinary classes and all-weight multiplier ideals for different coefficients.
The failure of a predetermined countable set of polar-current detectors applies even to analytic ideal models.
The claim is scoped to those detectors; it proves neither nonmetrizability of the whole space nor failure of every possible topology.
